taskTitle: Where ten HTTP header fields are defined

checks.detail: 1 phase had the tools designed for them

finalText:
Each field is defined in a current RFC. I opened every page I cite. The RFC 6797 and RFC 8288 headers don't show an "Obsoleted by" line. Each page I opened is the RFC Editor's HTML copy. RFC 8288 only says it obsoletes RFC 5988. I did not check the RFC Editor's status page for either of them.

- **Age, Cache-Control, Expires:** RFC 9111, sections 5.1, 5.2 and 5.3 (https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9111.html).
- **Last-Modified, ETag, Location, Retry-After, Vary:** RFC 9110, sections 8.8.2, 8.8.3, 10.2.2, 10.2.3 and 12.5.5 (https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110.html).
- **Strict-Transport-Security:** RFC 6797, section 6.1 (https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6797.html).
- **Link:** RFC 8288, section 3 (https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8288.html).

The Vary quote is the first part of its sentence. The rest of the sentence ("aside from the method and…") was cut off in the search result, so I quoted only the part I saw.
